architecture_scope: The task-state interfaces must remain reusable across raid sizes, difficulties, bosses, dungeons, and roles; Magmaw parasite control is only the first vertical slice.

first_broken_edge.cause: Magmaw reached combat with persistent task authority disabled; legacy parasite handling allowed Parasitic Infection and Infectious Vomit into the raid and did not provide a joined multi-tick task outcome.

next_action: Implement one authority-default-off parasite task-state vertical slice using the existing facts reducer, sticky raid coordinator, persistent task state, shared movement-candidate adapter, real arbiter, and typed native outcome feedback. Expand the three invalidated parasite fixtures at their real production adapter boundary; do not build or start a server yet.

allowed: Magmaw facts needed by the parasite task, without movement or assignment side effects
sticky Fire Mage and Marksman Hunter assignment with stable encounter epoch and assignment nonce
one persistent parasite bait, lane-transfer, and escape task lifecycle with explicit progress, suspension, completion, failure, and abort states
passive emission of all valid task and safety intents through the existing shared production movement-candidate adapter and BotActionArbitration kernel
typed native outcome feedback joined by actor, assignment, task generation, intent identity, and movement receipt
owner and non-owner simultaneous-hazard coverage, producer-order reversal, retryable Survival masking, rejected binding, and unknown-mechanic fail-closed coverage
fixture revisions magmaw_parasite_lane_paths_v1 revision 9, magmaw_parasite_lane_transition_full_replay_v1 revision 8, and magmaw_parasite_control_full_runtime_v1 revision 8
before and after CCN for every touched high-risk decision function and sub-1000-line C/C++ files
forbidden: bot-side Z adjustment, vertical steering, target-height normalization, teleportation, MMAP tolerance, fallback fraction, or global movement-planner changes
class rotation, DPS coefficient, pet, consumable, healer, tank, native encounter-script, SQL, route-coordinate, or roster changes
enabling task authority by default before shadow-versus-legacy identity and outcome fixtures pass
reordering legacy if branches as the implementation
a test-only candidate adapter, manually constructed successful native receipt, source-presence-only proof, or action submission treated as progress
configure, build, worldserver start, authserver start, live retry, DVC publication, or gameplay-clear claim

acceptance: facts, assignment, task state, intent arbitration, and native outcome feedback are distinct typed stages
the real manager and compiled fixtures use one shared production candidate adapter and the real arbitration kernel
the Mage and Hunter assignment and task destination remain stable across ordinary observation revisions and resume after safety preemption
non-owners cannot acquire parasite lane movement through a generic fallback while they may still target and damage threatening parasites from safe range
task progress requires measured native movement or a semantic mechanic outcome; submission alone is not progress
all three revised deterministic fixtures pass and the unchanged full Magmaw regression bank remains green
authority remains default-off and no terrain-following behavior changes
